mascots.name: 橙色柴犬
mascots.identity: A clearly identifiable Japanese Shiba Inu: orange short dense fur, broad round cheeks, cream-white urajiro muzzle and chest, small triangular upright ears, compact muzzle, black nose and a curled tail. Not a fox: no narrow pointed elongated snout, no oversized thin fox ears.
mascots.features: 橙色短毛、奶油色口鼻、立耳、卷尾

mascots.name: 熊猫
mascots.identity: An unmistakable giant panda: round black ears, white rounded face, separated black oval eye patches, black arms and legs, compact plump body. No pointed dog ears or dog snout.
mascots.features: 黑白眼斑、圆耳、圆润体形

mascots.name: 机器人
mascots.identity: An original friendly robot: rounded rectangular pearl-white ceramic head, smoked dark face panel with expressive small cyan LED eyes, small side circular mechanical ears, compact charcoal jointed limbs with visible believable hinges. No fur, no animal ears. Purple translucent visor as the family eyewear detail.
mascots.features: 陶瓷外壳、圆角面屏、青色眼灯

mascots.name: 柯基
mascots.identity: An unmistakable Welsh corgi: orange-tan and white fur, very large upright rounded-triangle ears, short sturdy legs, elongated compact torso, white center forehead blaze, blunt friendly muzzle. Not a generic Shiba or fox.
mascots.features: 大立耳、白额线、短腿长身

mascots.name: 奶牛猫
mascots.identity: An unmistakable original black-and-white tuxedo cat: black small triangular ears, white muzzle and central nose blaze, black fur cap and back, white paws, round feline whisker pads and short subtle whiskers, a curved long feline tail. No dog snout.

mascots.name: 兔子
mascots.identity: An unmistakable soft warm-white rabbit: two tall upright long ears with pale peach inner ears, a small split rabbit upper lip and tiny pink nose, rounded cheeks, short arms and oversized rabbit feet, small cotton tail. No dog muzzle.

mascots.name: 棕熊
mascots.identity: An unmistakable warm caramel-brown bear: two round ears, broad short taupe muzzle, compact black nose, stocky body and round paws, soft dense short plush fur. No canine triangular ears or panda eye patches.
mascots.features: 圆耳、短宽口鼻、厚实熊掌

mascots.name: 企鹅
mascots.identity: An unmistakable original small penguin: black velvety feathers, white rounded face and belly, short small orange beak, orange webbed feet, two short flipper arms. No animal ears, no fur muzzle, no hands with fingers.

mascots.name: 水獭
mascots.identity: An unmistakable river otter: chocolate-brown sleek velvety fur, broad cream-tan muzzle and cheek patches, tiny round ears low on head, black nose, subtle whiskers, long thick tapering otter tail, rounded short paws. No dog pointy ears.
mascots.features: 贴头圆耳、奶咖口鼻、粗长尾

mascots.name: 小恐龙
mascots.identity: An original mint-teal friendly baby tyrannosaur designer toy: broad rounded dinosaur snout, round nostrils, small simple dorsal plates on head/back, short two-clawed arms, sturdy dinosaur feet and a thick tail. Fine matte soft-vinyl skin, no fur, no wings or horns, not a dragon.
mascots.features: 薄荷绿、圆钝龙嘴、背脊、粗尾

custom_example.name: 自定义小象示范
custom_example.identity: Light slate-gray original elephant, big fan-shaped ears, short curled trunk, tiny tusks, natural round feet; same violet glasses, charcoal/orange streetwear and tactile designer-toy family.
custom_example.features: 原创小象：大耳、短卷鼻、灰色软胶
